messages.subject: layer_arcs function
parts:
Hi,

I can't find the way to use the layer_arcs function.

Here is the command that I've used (r, a data frame containing the following columns : Start, End,, Method) : 
r %>% ggvis() %>% layer_arcs(x = ~Start,, x2 = ~End, color = ~Method)

I've got this error message :
Erreur : Unknown properties: x2.
Did you mean: x?

Could you help me please ?
Thanx a lot

Audrey L.

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: layer_arcs function
parts:
Arcs take x, y, innerRadius, outerRadius, startAngle and endAngle.
Hadley
